problem: GitHub Actions recovery traffic amplified an already saturated queue.
root_cause: The repository-wide recovery supervisor ran on every main push and every five minutes, and could dispatch recovery workflows for many open PRs in one pass.
prevention: Never trigger repository-wide recovery scans from main pushes.
Apply repository-wide backpressure before dispatching recovery work.
Limit each recovery cycle to one PR.
Prefer deduplication and bounded scheduled recovery over fan-out.
